title: Pulse dashboard polish: unpin toast + sparkline persistence + remove dead reload_pins
description:
From GH issue thedouglenz/cruster#4. Three small dashboard nits, all in DashboardView (same module — keep as one PR to avoid rebase churn).

Nit 1: pressing 'x' (unpin) is silent. Add toast 'unpinned: <kind/ns/name>' mirroring the existing pin toast. Use the same pending-toast mechanism as pending_prompt_trigger / pending_export, or add a take_pending_toast trait method.

Nit 2: per-pin sparklines reset every dashboard visit because view_for_id constructs a fresh DashboardView. Cheapest fix: cache the dashboard view in App (change current_view to enum { Dashboard(DashboardView), Other(Box<dyn ResourceView>) } or similar). Disk persistence and background-task options are overkill for v1.

Nit 3: DashboardView::reload_pins is defined but never called. If Nit 2 picks option (a), wire it up; otherwise delete it.

Acceptance:
- Pressing 'x' on a pin shows a toast naming the unpinned resource
- Dashboard -> pods -> dashboard preserves per-pin sparkline history within a session
- reload_pins either deleted or has a real caller
- cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings stays clean
- Existing dashboard tests pass; ideally a new test covers unpin-toast and sparkline-persistence

title: why-pending: diagnose stuck Pending pods (#18)
description: Implements cruster GH#18 (full spec in issue). New files: cruster-core/diagnose/pending.rs, verbs/why_pending.rs, schemas/why-pending.schema.json. Heuristics: unschedulable_no_nodes, taints, affinity, resources, pvc_unbound, image_pull_failure, missing_serviceaccount, unknown. ≥9 unit tests. Reuse verbs/export::fetch_events. Refuses non-Pending pods.

title: why-init-failure: diagnose init-container failures (#20)
description: Implements cruster GH#20 (full spec in issue). New files: cruster-core/diagnose/init.rs, verbs/why_init_failure.rs, schemas/why-init-failure.schema.json. Reads status.initContainerStatuses. Heuristics: init_oom_killed, auth_failure, connectivity_failure, permission_denied, missing_path, init_config_missing, init_image_pull_failure, init_stuck_pending, unknown. ≥6 unit tests. SHARES log-signal regexes with #17 — if #17 ships first, extract shared module to cruster-core::diagnose::log_signals.

title: why-no-endpoints: diagnose services with no live endpoints (#19)
description: Implements cruster #19. Structural diagnostic (no log parsing). New files: cruster-core/diagnose/endpoints.rs, verbs/why_no_endpoints.rs, schemas/why-no-endpoints.schema.json. ≥6 unit tests covering 6 reason enum values.

title: why-init-failure: diagnose init-container failures (#18)
description: Implements cruster #18. Reads status.initContainerStatuses, uses shared log_signals from #17. New files: cruster-core/diagnose/init.rs, verbs/why_init_failure.rs, schemas/why-init-failure.schema.json. ≥6 unit tests.

title: why-crashloop: diagnose CrashLoopBackOff pods (#17)
description: Implements cruster #17. Spec in issue. Creates cruster-core/diagnose/crashloop.rs + log_signals (shared with #18/#19/#20), args.rs, verbs/why_crashloop.rs, schemas/why-crashloop.schema.json. ≥6 unit tests.

title: cruster doctor: preflight CLI for kubeconfig + cluster connectivity (#22)
description: Implements cruster GH#22 (full spec in issue). New module cruster-core/doctor with checks.rs. Each check returns CheckResult{name,status,message,fix}. 10 v1 checks: kubeconfig_parses, current_context_set, kubectl_on_path, apiserver_reachable, can_list_pods, can_list_namespaces, metrics_server_present, cruster_config_writable, cruster_cache_writable, license_loadable. CLI: cruster doctor [--json]. Exit 0/1/2 by max severity. Never throws. ≥8 unit tests + integration. Update README + skills/cruster-investigate-pod.
